description:
Outcome: Door volunteer adds a first name and repair item, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: API, accessible form, confirmation and agreed access controls. Excludes: edit/delete and SMS.
Acceptance: Valid input creates exactly one waiting entry; invalid input is rejected; repeated submission or retry after an uncertain response does not silently duplicate the visitor.
Behaviour: Accessible field errors, pending state and success feedback; safe recovery from network failure.
Verification: API/UI integration tests for valid, invalid and duplicate/retry submissions. Prerequisites: T-004. Assumptions: apply owner decisions from T-002.
title: Add a visitor end to end
